keyword: who puts the green jacket on a repeat winner

verifications.claim: When a player wins the Masters in consecutive years, the Augusta National Golf Club Chairman puts the green jacket on them, rather than the previous year's winner.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'the last two times there was a repeat champion, with Nick Faldo in 1990 and Tiger Woods in 2002, the club’s chairman assisted'; R2: 'the Augusta National Golf Club chairman to put the jacket on him'; R3: 'Traditionally, the club chairman puts the jacket on the repeat champion'; R4: 'When Nick Faldo (in 1990), Tiger Woods (in 2002), and Rory McIlroy (in 2026) won in consecutive years, the chairman of Augusta National put the jacket on them'; R5: 'Tournament traditions call for the club's chairman... to put the jacket (back) on the defending champion'; R6: 'That distinction would go to the chairman of Augusta National, Fred Ridley'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state that for repeat winners (post-1966), the chairman performs the ceremony instead of the previous winner (who is the same person).

verifications.claim: The Chairman handles this duty to avoid the winner putting the green jacket on themselves.
verifications.label: OMITTED
verifications.reasoning: Sources describe the chairman performing the duty for repeat winners but do not state or imply the explicit reason is 'to avoid the winner putting the green jacket on themselves'; 1966 is noted as an exception where self-donning occurred.
